ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows approximately 55% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels and 45% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields dominate the lateral-central regions of both lobes. A wide, low-intensity black contiguous band bisects the fluke vertically from the notch. Two distinct, small circular black pixel clusters are isolated in the mid-section of the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 62 degrees, with the apex partially obscured by water-surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography exhibiting high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) of varying pixel-amplitude (1-5 pixels) along the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a concave sweep trajectory, curving upwards and outwards from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular textured pixels indicating barnacle colonization visible on the extreme left lateral tip and along the upper-right trailing margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular jagged depressions along the trailing edge consistent with prior physical trauma; localized parasitic/epibiotic colonization on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pixel staining localized on the interior-medial white regions of both lobes, contrasting with the primary white pigment.
